Title: tomasghilino/secure-ai-agent

A security‑first AI operations agent that combines hybrid Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) with verified citations, a LangGraph workflow that requires human approval before execution, role‑based tool access, row‑level security for data isolation, and a pinned MCP server for controlled communication. The architecture is designed to limit exposure, enforce accountability, and provide auditable traces of AI decisions while maintaining operational flexibility.

Title: pauljump/pricefixed
Summary: An open-source platform that aggregates actual rental prices and historical data for every New York City apartment, extracting information from proprietary listings and creating a standardized public record for each building. The dataset is intended for AI agents to analyze and develop applications that address rent price fixing. The project claims to “unfix” rents by increasing market transparency, though the completeness and accuracy of the data remain to be independently verified.

signals.brief_en:
Title: skatteguru/skills
Content: This brief outlines the core competencies required for AI agents operating in open-source intelligence (OSINT) contexts. Key skills include: data collection from diverse, publicly available sources; verification and cross‑referencing to assess reliability; natural language processing for multilingual extraction; pattern recognition for anomaly detection; ethical compliance with privacy and legal frameworks; and adaptive learning to incorporate emerging data sources. These capabilities enable strategic analysis while maintaining professional rigor and acknowledging inherent uncertainties in open data.

العنوان: skatteguru/skills

signals.score_reason: Twitter/X discussion signal. Final score: 40. Freshness: source age 0.03d.
signals.brief_en: Brief: Cloudflare EU control panel outage (since 18:24 UTC). Dashboard and related APIs in the EU region are failing or returning errors, hindering automation (Terraform, CI, DNS scripts). The edge network continues to serve cached content and security features remain operational. Impact: configuration changes, token rotation, and deployments cannot be performed via the EU control plane, though traffic continues unchanged. Mitigation: use non‑EU API endpoints, maintain runbooks that operate without the dashboard, and rely on DNS rollbacks that do not require the control panel.
signals.brief_ar: ملخص: انقطاع لوحة التحكم الخاصة بـ Cloudflare في منطقة الاتحاد الأوروبي منذ 18:24 UTC. لوحة التحكم والواجهات البرمجية المرتبطة في المنطقة الأوروبية تفشل أو تُعيد أخطاء، مما يعرقل الأتمتة (Terraform، CI، سكريبتات DNS). شبكة الحافة تستمر في تقديم المحتوى المخزن مؤقتًا وتظل ميزات الأمان تعمل. الأثر: لا يمكن إجراء تغييرات تكوين، أو تدوير الرموز، أو نشر تحديثات عبر لوحة التحكم الأوروبية، بينما يظل المرور يتدفق كما هو. التخفيف: استخدم نقاط النهاية غير الأوروبية للـ API، واحتفظ بدليل تشغيل لا يعتمد على لوحة التحكم، واعتمد على عكس تغييرات DNS التي لا تحتاج إلى لوحة التحكم.
